The consecutive pairs lock into two blocks. Gus is immediately after Hana, and Finn is two slots after Hana, so those three occupy Hana–Gus–Finn in a row. Ben is immediately after Cara, and that pair sits fully before Hana, with Ben at least three slots from Gus, so Ben is at least two slots before Hana. Ivo is before Gus and at least three slots from Hana, so Ivo is at least three slots before Hana.

The only start that also fits Ann, Dev, Cara, and Ben is Hana in 7. Ann is before Ben, at least three slots away, with exactly one slot between Ann and Dev. Dev is before both Ben and Hana. Ben is at least three slots from Ivo. Those conditions fill every named slot. The remaining person is Eve in slot 6.
